raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
SLK Software Pvt. Ltd. | Bengaluru, Karnataka | Client: Regions Bank and Synovus Bank Senior Operations / Program Manager | July 2025 – March 2026
Led a 130-member risk and audit team, strengthening SLK's global risk posture through SOP reforms, policy rewrites and risk-control enhancements, improving audit accuracy by 22%.
Oversaw multiple teams and projects across a larger account/portfolio, ensuring operational priorities, delivery requirements and performance objectives remained aligned.
Led strategic planning, budgeting and P&L accountability, where applicable. • Managed senior-level client relationships and business growth support, maintaining stakeholder engagement across the account. • Mentored managers and drove leadership development across the team. • Set operational strategy, process improvement initiatives and compliance oversight across the function. • Reported to leadership on performance metrics, risks and issues, providing visibility into operational performance and control effectiveness. • Drove Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs), Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Monthly Program Reviews (MPRs), consolidating audit insights, risk trends and operational performance for senior leadership decision-making.
Led the annual Talent Review for the 130-member risk and audit team, managing promotions, succession planning and long-term career development pathways.
Owned end-to-end performance management, including goal-setting, quarterly check-ins, competency assessments and development planning.
Conducted interviews and capability assessments for new auditors and managers to maintain hiring standards. • Implemented structured training and calibration programmes, reducing inter-auditor variance by 28% and improving reviewer proficiency.
Operations Manager | June 2023 – July 2025
Conducted root-cause investigations on escalations, identifying policy gaps, violation patterns and operational loopholes; implemented corrective measures that reduced repeat defects by 20–30% quarter-over-quarter.
Drove incident-response governance, triaging high-impact audit failures and coordinating corrective actions with Security, Operations, Legal and Risk teams to prevent recurrence.
Managed operational migration activities for card operations, coordinating process transition, resource readiness, documentation, stakeholder dependencies and issue resolution through BAU stabilisation.
Owned assigned country/workstream delivery for card operations, tracking milestones, dependencies, actions and readiness requirements across Operations, Technology, Risk and other stakeholders.
Owned RAID management for assigned workstreams, tracking risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and actions, and driving mitigation, escalation and timely closure with stakeholders.
Coordinated cutover activities for card operations, ensuring operational readiness, stakeholder sign-offs, issue closure and support arrangements were in place for go-live.
• Led operational handover to BAU teams following migration, coordinating knowledge transfer, SOPs, readiness checks, open issues and
post-go-live support.
• Developed and maintained detailed L5/L6 process documentation and SOPs for card operations, supporting process transition,
standardisation, training and BAU readiness.
Used JIRA to track project/workstream actions, delivery milestones, issues, dependencies and readiness activities through implementation and transition.
Built and deployed risk dashboards and compliance metrics, improving leadership decision-making and reducing audit cycle time by 35%; managed confidential investigation data in accordance with InfoSec and privacy requirements.
Managed team/project delivery, SLA/KPI tracking and risk mitigation, ensuring quality, timelines and compliance standards were consistently met.
Owned client communication and stakeholder management, handling escalations and coordinating across multiple departments. • Managed third-party contracts and service-level agreements, and supported RFPs by tailoring content to client needs and regulatory requirements.
Drove effort estimation, staff allocation and resource planning to support revenue and profitability targets, including performance reviews and schedule optimisation.
Established monthly goals, communicated priorities and tracked progress; trained and supported less experienced staff in managing workloads and assignments.
Infosys BPM Ltd. | Bengaluru, Karnataka | Client: SunTrust Banks, subsequently merged with BB&T Assistant Manager | January 2022 – June 2023 Team Leader | October 2019 – December 2021
Led teams of up to 100+ analysts across Fraud Operations and the Financial Crime Unit (AML/KYC), including a 65+ member fraud investigations team and a 60 FTE deposit/card fraud team supporting one of the largest US retail banks, consistently achieving 100% TAT and 99%+ accuracy.
Maintained fraud loss mitigation below $50K through effective case prioritization, decision-making and process controls; recognized with the Best Team Lead Award and multiple Ramp Awards.
Coached, trained and performance-managed team members, promoting quality, compliance and continuous improvement across operations.
Reviewed flagged transactions and investigated deposited checks for potential fraud, escalating cases for decisioning and taking appropriate actions including blocking accounts/cards and re-issuing cards in line with process guidelines.
Investigated disputed transactions using case management systems and the Enterprise Fraud Management Process, reporting findings in accordance with Regulation E and US banking regulations; handled Debit, Gift and ATM card disputes.
Prepared daily and weekly MIS reports and fraud trend analysis, and conducted WBRs and MBRs with stakeholders covering operational performance and risk metrics.
Ensured compliance with BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, FinCEN guidelines and OFAC sanctions, including risk assessments, policy/procedure development and employee training.
Investigated potential sanctions violations and monitored transactions for suspicious activity, preparing and submitting reports to relevant authorities.
Liaised with clients, Risk teams and law enforcement/compliance stakeholders on complex cases and drove process improvements that reduced fraud losses and false positives.
Corporate Card Operations & Migration
Managed operational migration activities for Corporate Card operations, coordinating process transition, operational readiness, documentation, dependencies and issue resolution through BAU stabilisation.
Owned assigned card operations workstreams, tracking delivery milestones, dependencies, readiness requirements and stakeholder actions across Operations, Technology, Risk and partner teams.
Owned RAID for the Corporate Card migration, tracking operational, technology and readiness risks; drove mitigation and escalation of critical dependencies and maintained closure through go-live.
Coordinated UAT, operational readiness and cutover activities, tracking outstanding issues, dependencies and stakeholder sign-offs through go-live.
Coordinated people, process, system, control and training readiness for Corporate Card migration, tracking outstanding actions and stakeholder sign-offs and supporting cutover execution through go-live.
Led transition to the receiving BAU team, completing knowledge transfer, L5/L6 SOPs, process documentation, control requirements and outstanding actions, with post-go-live support through stabilisation.
Developed and maintained detailed L5/L6 SOPs and process documentation, supporting operational transition, process standardisation, training and BAU readiness.
Used JIRA to track project/workstream actions, delivery milestones, issues, dependencies, defects and readiness activities throughout implementation and transition.
Supported card operations and implementation activities involving Mainframe-based processing environments, working with Technology teams on system readiness, testing and production issues.
Process Analyst | June 2015 – October 2019
Processed 4,000+ Commercial Card applications, activations and transaction queries monthly, consistently maintaining 100% TAT compliance.
• Maintained quality scores of 99.5%+, consistently exceeding operational benchmarks. • Resolved card disputes, chargebacks and billing discrepancies, supporting timely resolution and a seamless cardholder experience.
• Ensured compliance with Visa and Mastercard scheme regulations and internal SLAs through accurate processing, documentation and
controls.
Monitored and resolved declined transactions, credit-limit adjustments and billing errors as part of day-to-day Commercial Card operations. • Coordinated with clients and cardholders on account-related queries while maintaining accurate records and documentation to support audit readiness.
